originalTitle: Trump says he spoke recently to Fed Chairman Warsh, denies regular calls
summary: The president said he had recently been in touch with the Fed chairman, but denied regular contact amid concerns about central bank independence.
content:
President Donald Trump spoke recently to Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh, the president said Monday.

The Wall Street Journal reported Wednesday that Trump and Warsh had spoken repeatedly since Warsh became chairman of the central bank in May. Trump said that story was wrong, but he confirmed that he and Warsh had been in touch "one time, briefly, a few days ago."

The report came amid concerns about Fed independence from Trump, who has broken with most of his predecessors to weigh in on interest rate policy. Warsh has said he is happy to hear from the president or anyone else on interest rates but will make up his own mind about where rates should go.

The Fed didn't respond to a request for comment.

Read more CNBC politics and policy coverage

Direct contact between the president and the Fed has been rare in recent years. Trump had only one regular, scheduled meeting with former Chair Jerome Powell since returning to the presidency in 2025. The two also toured a Fed construction site together after Trump alleged that Powell had mismanaged the renovation project.

Otherwise, Trump has put extreme pressure on the Fed. Last week, he revived an effort to fire Governor Lisa Cook , who is serving a 14-year term on the Fed's Board. It wasn't clear if the Trump-Warsh conversation came before or after that call.

Trump has said Warsh should lower interest rates while insisting that the Fed chairman has the latitude to do otherwise.

"If it was up to him, it would be different, but he's got a board," Trump said Monday.

"But they made it sound like I live and breathe — you know, I speak to Kevin all the time, every time. I spoke to him one time," Trump said.

Congress gave the Fed the power to set interest rates independently of political considerations. In the 1970s, a too-close relationship between Fed Chairman Arthur Burns and President Richard Nixon preceded a sharp bout of inflation.

Warsh's calendar for June showed that he met three times with Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, continuing a longstanding custom of the two officials meeting regularly for breakfast.
chineseTitle: 特朗普称他最近与美联储主席沃什通话，但否认定期通话
chineseSummary: 总统表示，他最近与美联储主席保持了联系，但出于对央行独立性的担忧，他否认定期联系。
chineseContent:
唐纳德·特朗普总统周一表示，他最近与美联储主席凯文·沃什进行了交谈。

《华尔街日报》周三报道称，自沃什五月就任央行主席以来，特朗普和沃什多次通话。特朗普表示这个故事是错误的，但他证实他和沃什“几天前曾短暂接触过一次”。

该报告发布之际，人们对美联储独立于特朗普的担忧之际，特朗普与大多数前任都打破了对利率政策的影响。沃什表示，他很高兴听到总统或其他任何人关于利率的意见，但他会自己决定利率的走向。

美联储没有回应置评请求。

阅读更多 CNBC 政治和政策报道

近年来，总统与美联储之间的直接接触很少见。自2025年重返总统职位以来，特朗普只与前主席杰罗姆·鲍威尔进行了一次定期会面。在特朗普声称鲍威尔翻修工程管理不善后，两人还一起参观了美联储的一个建筑工地。

否则，特朗普就对美联储施加了极大的压力。上周，他再次试图解雇在美联储理事会任职 14 年的州长丽莎·库克 (Lisa Cook)。目前尚不清楚特朗普与沃什的谈话是在那次通话之前还是之后进行的。

特朗普表示沃什应该降低利率，同时坚称美联储主席有权采取其他行动。

特朗普周一表示：“如果由他决定，情况会有所不同，但他有一个董事会。”

“但他们听起来就像我在生活和呼吸——你知道，我每次都和凯文说话。我和他说过一次，”特朗普说。

国会赋予美联储独立于政治考虑设定利率的权力。 20 世纪 70 年代，美联储主席阿瑟·伯恩斯 (Arthur Burns) 与总统理查德·尼克松 (Richard Nixon) 之间的关系过于密切，导致了一场剧烈的通货膨胀。

沃什六月份的日历显示，他与财政部长斯科特·贝森特会面了三次，延续了两位官员定期共进早餐的长期惯例。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
